summary: This is a reference-only Solana guidance skill covering rent, SPL token accounts, fees, transaction lifecycle, common errors, RPC and explorer notes, and wallet-safety advice. It declares no environment variables, asks for no keys, seeds or wallets, installs nothing and sends no data. It only mentions public RPC and explorer hosts and the optional spl-token and solana CLI commands as examples. The one metadata block is metadata.clawdbot, which OpenClaw ignores.

findings.message: Metadata uses a metadata.clawdbot block (emoji, os list) instead of metadata.openclaw, so OpenClaw ignores it and treats what it declares as undeclared.
The skill only gives wallet-safety advice (approval prompts can drain a wallet) and does not request or handle any private key, seed or wallet credential.
The skill card tells users never to expose seed phrases or private keys, so it handles no wallet secrets.
It names the public RPC host api.mainnet-beta.solana.com and paid providers (Helius, QuickNode, Triton) only as documentation, with no data sent by the skill itself.
It suggests the local CLI command `spl-token close`, which assumes the Solana tooling binaries are installed although no binaries are declared.
